text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. I guess it's time to replace my
tracksuit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It feels tight in some places when I
move. Looks
like I gained some muscle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As always, meat reigns supreme.
It's good
for your muscles, no doubt
about it.

Curious, I take a look at the results of
this
morning's physical, and...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Looks like your skeletal muscle percentage has dropped a bit...
Looks like your skeletal muscle percentage went down a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: In other words, what actually increased was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And wipe that smirk off your face! Argh!

Narita Brian gets back into shape after
some
grueling runs.
